prompt:
An editorial still life of plant ingredients, seen from slightly above at about a 40 degree angle, on a pale blush-pink linen cloth in soft morning window light from the left. Loosely arranged with generous calm space between them, grouped a little right of centre: a small cluster of deep red grapes with a few loose brown grape seeds beside it, a curled piece of reddish-brown maritime pine bark, a small unglazed ceramic dish of dark blue bilberries, a pinch of loose dried green tea and black tea leaves, a thin slice of orange, and one orange marigold flower.

Muted, natural, true-to-life colours that sit well with blush pink and deep wine red. Shallow depth of field, soft shadows, fine linen texture, quiet and elegant, like a high-end magazine food and botanical photograph.

No text, no labels, no bottles, no capsules, no hands, no people, no watermark.
